newsitem.title: JAPAN: S&P assigns A+ to Mitsubishi Estate straight bonds.
newsitem.headline: S&P assigns A+ to Mitsubishi Estate straight bonds.

text.p: Standard & Poor's Corp said on Thursday that it had assigned an A+ rating to Mitsubishi Estate Co Ltd's domestic straight bonds.

The A+ rating was assigned to the company's 10 billion yen 2.125 percent domestic straight bonds due May 30, 2002, 20 billion yen 2.350 percent domestic straight bonds due May 30, 2003 and 30 billion yen 2.975 percent domestic straight bonds due May 30, 2007, S&P said in a statement.
The rating outlook is negative, it said.
